title: Dataset Metadata
description: Study-level metadata for a neuroimaging dataset. Contains what modalities are present, participant demographics (from participants.tsv), signal properties shared across recordings, event/HED annotation status, and provenance. Aligned with BIDS dataset_description.json and participants.tsv. Platform-neutral; platform-specific fields belong in extensions.

schema_version.description: Envelope field: schema version (present when validated through root schema).

doc_type.description: Envelope field: document type (present when validated through root schema).

dataset_id.description: Unique dataset identifier (e.g., 'ds003645' for OpenNeuro, 'nm000108' for NEMAR).

description.description: Short abstract or description of the dataset.

recording_modality.description: Recording modalities present in the dataset (e.g., ['EEG', 'MEG', 'MRI']). Dataset-level property; individual data files inherit their modality from the BIDS datatype directory.

bids_version.description: BIDS specification version the dataset follows.

authors.description: List of dataset authors as structured person objects.

funding.description: Funding sources with structured grant information.

funder_identifier.description: Persistent identifier for the funder (e.g., Crossref Funder ID, ROR ID).

award_uri.description: URI to the award or grant information page.

tasks.description: Experimental tasks present in the dataset.

datatypes.description: BIDS datatype directories present in the dataset (e.g., ['eeg', 'anat']).

sessions.description: Session labels present in the dataset (e.g., ['pre', 'post']).

sessions_count.description: Number of sessions in the dataset.

has_hed_annotations.description: Whether the dataset includes Hierarchical Event Descriptors (HED) annotations.

hed_version.description: Version of the HED schema used for annotations (e.g., '8.1.0').

has_event_annotations.description: Whether the dataset includes event/stimulus annotations (events.tsv files).

keywords.description: Subject terms and keywords for findability. Supports both plain keywords (term only) and controlled vocabulary entries (with scheme and URI). Aligns with DataCite Subject (property 6).

related_identifiers.description: Related resources: associated papers, source datasets, code repositories, prior versions. These links feed into scholarly knowledge graphs and citation indices. Aligns with DataCite RelatedIdentifier (property 12).

data_papers.description: Papers, or deposits of the same data, that a trusted judgment classified as this dataset's own data paper. More reliable than the relation type on related_identifiers, which is only a hint. Key absent means the dataset has not been judged yet; an empty array means it was judged and has no data paper. The dataset's own DOI is not listed here (see external_links).

contributors.description: Contributors with typed roles beyond the primary authors. Includes data collectors, hosting institutions, project leaders, etc. Aligns with DataCite Contributor (property 7).

dates.description: Semantically typed dates: data collection period, creation date, publication date, etc. Aligns with DataCite Date (property 8).

rights.description: Structured license/rights entries with URIs and machine-readable identifiers. Complements the simpler 'license' string field. Aligns with DataCite Rights (property 16).

language.description: Primary language of the dataset content (IETF BCP 47 tag, e.g., 'en'). Aligns with DataCite Language (property 9).
